---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Dustin Tharp"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/seda_2025.duckdb")
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, score_2015 = rla_score) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_dist |>
      filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
      select(district_id, score_2023 = rla_score),
    by = "district_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(rla_change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  select(district_id, rla_change) |>
  collect()
state_change <- tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_2015 = rla_score) |>
  inner_join(
    tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
      filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
      select(stateabb, score_2023 = rla_score),
    by = "stateabb"
  ) |>
  mutate(score_change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
score_change |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rla_change, fill = rla_change > 0)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with scores in both years:", nrow(score_change)),
    caption = "Reading score change from 2015 to 2023",
    x = "Reading score change",
    y = "Number of districts",
    fill = "Positive change"
  )
```

```{r}
state_change |>
  ggplot(aes(
    y = reorder(state_name, score_2023),
    color = score_change > 0
  )) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = score_2015, xend = score_2023, yend = state_name),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"))
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = score_2015), color = "gray") +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Scores: 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "Arrows show the change from 2015 to 2023; states are sorted by 2023 score",
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores. Arrow color indicates direction of change.",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Improved"
  )
```
